**What I did:**
- I messaged June asking her to approve the mail to Pree, and logged it as an approval request. I didn't include the $1,805 figure in that message.
- I replied to you here explaining the hold-up.

Once June approves, I'll save the draft to Pree (psundaram@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tansleigh 2027 rate" and the proposed 2027 rate of $1,805 a seat, ready for you to send. You're also welcome to ask June or Anselm yourself.
